main_text.p: taphoricè Chald. est Scindere, secare æquor, flumina, aquas, Transfire, trajicere, transvadare flumen, transfretare: Hinc Syr. ܥܒܪ ܬܗܘܐ ܕܡܝܐ ܬܐܘܪܐ The-saurus qui non præterit, transit, Lucæ 12.33. Aphel אגיז Traducere.
נוֹאָה, נוֹאָה, נוֹאָא Ch. Eunuchus, quasi Excisus dictus: Plur. נוֹאִין.
מגיזת, מגיזא Ch. Vadum, Transitus. Plur. מגיזין, מגיזתא. Scribitur & quandoq; absque ʼ, & ʼ cum Dagesch, ac si esset àנוֹגָא. Deinde est Ponto, Navis trajectoria, Scapha, 2.Sam.19.18.

גוח Ch. Exire, prodire, prorumpere, erumpere, Jobi 38.8. Aphel אגיח Idem. Cum Nomine קרב, אגיח קרב Inire, Movere bellum, pugnare, præliari. Hoc sensu multa reperiuntur puncta אגח, quasi à גנח. Ithpeh. אתגנח Pugnatum est, Judic.5.20.
גול Ch. Membrana, Pergamena, על גויללא Super pergamena, Deut.31.24. Jon.
גום גומתא Ch. Fossa, Fovea, יעבר גומתא בארעא Facit foveam in terra, Jobi 39.27.
גון גונא Ch. Color: Item Modus, Forma, ratio, similitudo: Item Occupatio, Negotium, Res. Plur. גונין Negotia, Ecclef.5.3. Colores, Numer.2.3.in Jon.
Ethpahel גום Syr. Confugere, refugere, refugiū habere, recipere se, Act.14.16. ad Hebr.6.18.
מנוסא Ch. Fructum, Segmentum. Plur. מנוסין דלחם Frusta panis, Ezech.13.19.

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew words are set in small print and could not be read letter by letter; they are transcribed approximately. Catchword מגיסא is a faint Hebrew word at the foot right.
